tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: "Where do they make these shoes?"

B builds the answer from the tiles. Make a passive sentence: the right form of be + the past participle of the blue verb. Check the time words (yesterday, next year, at the moment) to choose the tense.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: "At the moment": is being + past participle.

tandemRedemittel.p1: Sorry? Can you say that again, please?
